title: run-recon warning
description: One warning the run logged, in order, duplicates removed (run.json keeps the first 200). Since x-minor 1 (Outcrop 1.21) a run-health warning also carries its kind, the host and seed it is about, and its counts.

kind.description: What the warning is about, for a warning the run-health check made: waf_blocked (the host answered with a WAF vendor's block page) or throttled (429s, resets, timeouts and TLS name errors over the run's threshold). Absent on other warnings. Later minors may add kinds.

fields.description: waf_blocked: vendor and statuses (comma-separated HTTP status codes of the block pages).

counts.description: Per host: requests (the validation pass's attempts), blocked (block pages among them), http_429, timeouts, resets, tls_name_errors, refused, crawl_errors and nuclei_errors (lines in those tools' error logs).
